get.summary: Page the focused agent and all recorded spawn descendants at a retained snapshot

200.description: A bounded forward page, or a metadata-only count pass. Private continuations bind the view, subject, filters, mode and deletion visibility. A replacement window lease retains the same snapshot. Returning without a cursor starts at the first page.

default.description: Request, authorization, state or storage error

get.summary: List proven own activations at a retained snapshot

default.description: Request, authorization, state or storage error

get.description: Bounded execution summaries in stable reference order, independent of selected history. Each row includes an activation reference, own execution state and evidenced durations.

get.summary: Read bounded typed object collections or result availability

parameters.name: at_snapshot
parameters.description: Required for result_representations; names the view containing its authenticated continuation.

parameters.name: representation
parameters.description: Required for results and result_representations. Cursors cannot cross representations.

parameters.name: result_phase
parameters.description: Required with after when continuing a result_representations probe; omitted for the initial probe.

parameters.name: selection
parameters.description: Inspect objects in this retained history selection; cursors cannot cross selections.

default.description: Request, authorization, state or storage error

get.description: Result pages require a representation. Result catalogue continuations use kind=result_representations and bind both result_phase and after to the retained view and current authorization.

default.description: Request, authorization, state or storage error

200.description: Bounded exact payload range authorized through the supplied object, revision, representation and view. Content-Type follows retained derivation metadata; Content-Range reports the returned byte extent.

get.summary: Page retained context-origin assertions independently of history selection

default.description: Request, authorization, state or storage error

get.description: One row per authorized lineage claim. Origin navigation requires independently authorized target metadata; unresolved and unavailable targets remain explicit.

get.summary: Stream a complete retained environment evidence archive at a fixed cut
get.description: Framed sylph-evidence-jsonl stream with exact base64 payload ranges. A completion footer verifies frame count, prefix bytes and SHA-256. Missing completion is a failed archive, including after HTTP headers were sent. The scope includes other sessions and source inventories in the authorized environment.

parameters.name: buffered
parameters.description: Apply the separate bounded browser-buffer limit when no transactional file writer is available.

parameters.name: duration_ms
parameters.description: Optional shorter lifetime, never above the resolved export limit.

parameters.name: max_bytes
parameters.description: Optional lower output bound; cannot exceed the resolved streaming or buffered budget.

200.description: Streaming archive; verify its completion footer before committing a file.

default.description: Authorization, retained-view, capacity or input error

SessionId.description: Opaque native identity tuple environment:agent:native_id; not a UUID.

origin.description: Only currently authorized retained target metadata; absent when unresolved or unavailable.
